g.text: Reproduce from this directory with `MCPJAM_API_URL` and `MCPJAM_API_KEY` set:
npx mcpjam server doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --quiet --format json > doctor.json
npx mcpjam tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --tool-name add --tool-args '"'"'{"a":2,"b":3}'"'"' --quiet --format json > fi
The CLI is pinned to 6.2.2 in package-lock.json. Python uses only the standard library. No credentials are saved in these files. T
he runner reuses suite-created.json; remove that file to author a new suite from suite.json in another compatible account. Each in
vocation starts a new run and saves its status and iteration evidence. It exits nonzero on a platform failure or an incorrect/miss
- MCPJam doctor: ready; Streamable HTTP; protocol 2025-11-25; arithmetic-fixture 1.0.0; no OAuth required; one tool, add.
- First direct call: add({"a":2,"b":3}) returned structuredContent {"sum":5}, isError false.
- Saved suite: suite_authored_5. Latest verified run: run_fixture_5. Completed, platform passed 1/1.
- Independent exact evaluation: evaluation.json passed. It requires exactly one add call, exact input arguments, exact structured
- Local negative control: `python3 check-result.py 999 iterations.json local-negative-control.json` exits 1 as expected.
This isolated API labels runs SIMULATED: deterministic execution, no hosted model or live billing. These results establish the det
erministic arithmetic path, not model tool selection or full protocol conformance.
The documented server validate route returned 404. Direct CLI doctor worked. Prompt execution and several documented assertions re
turned 422 FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED; the message did not identify the unsupported assertion. A toolCall followed by responseContains
**The hosted assertion verdict is unreliable in this environment.** A separate saved negative-control suite (suite_authored_6, run
_fixture_4) expected responseContains needle 999, yet the API reported passed while the actual sum was 5. See negative-control.jso
n. Accordingly, the repeatable runner grades actual iteration evidence with check-result.py instead of relying on the platform ver
dict alone. The local grading check rejects 999 correctly. No report was sent externally.
The decision-summary route also returned 404; iteration evidence remains available. Earlier exploratory suites are retained in the
isolated account for audit; the canonical runnable suite is suite.json / suite_authored_5.
Downloaded documentation snapshots are included. Only public documentation, CLI commands, MCP requests, and authenticated public A
